headline: Memory price increases emerge: September computer-related product prices hit record high | Industry
summary: Taiwan's September prices for education equipment, including computers and flash drives, rose 9.75%. It was the 10th consecutive monthly rise and the largest increase in over 44 years of records.
why: Memory chip prices are driven by AI data center demand and affect costs for PC, smartphone and server makers across the supply chain.
